project: Northern Metropolis: The Surreal Dreamscape (大宋盛景·云上凡尘)
description: 东方超现实主义运镜短片 · MuseCanvas 视频提示词工程

shots.title: 天穹穿云 · 极速俯冲
shots.camera: 90度高速俯冲推镜 (Breakneck Dive Crane Tracking) ➔ 贴地拉平
shots.positive_prompt: Cinematic master shot, continuous fluid downward dive crane tracking shot descending smoothly from celestial golden clouds down to ancient bustling Chang'an capital during Song Dynasty, seamless continuous optical flow, surreal magical realism: floating ancient pavilions and inverted ethereal pagodas suspended weightlessly in golden sunrise mist, camera glides at high speed parting the clouds, swooping millimeters above glowing terracotta tiled rooftops, gently leveling out into crowded street at eye-level, thousands of citizens walking harmoniously, warm morning volumetric sunbeams, 18mm wide anamorphic lens, IMAX scale, breathtaking visual depth, photorealistic architectural details, stable temporal coherence, fluid physical momentum, 8k resolution --ar 16:9 --motion 7
shots.negative_prompt: sudden camera jerk, stutter, frame freeze, jitter, modern cars, modern skyscrapers, blurry, 3d video game, cartoon, plastic textures, dull lighting, abrupt cut
shots.audio_cue: 0~8s 破空风声 ➔ 晨雾散去涌入市井万民喧闹嗡鸣 + 空灵青铜编钟

shots.title: 人间烟火 · 白汽化灵
shots.camera: 低空贴地斯坦尼康滑轨 (Low-Angle Steadicam Tracking) ➔ 仰角聚焦蒸笼
shots.positive_prompt: Smooth steadicam tracking shot pushing forward seamlessly through bustling Song Dynasty market street, pedestrians strolling, ornate wooden carts with brass bells, camera gently tilting up towards a steaming giant bamboo dumpling steamer, street vendor wearing linen robe lifting the lid: dense glowing white steam magically coalesces into living luminous golden koi fish and celestial white cranes soaring into the air above the roofs, children reaching out laughing in wonder, glowing light specks drifting gently, surreal Eastern fantasy, steady fluid camera motion, zero motion stutter, rich vibrant silk colors, volumetric lighting, photorealistic textures, 8k --ar 16:9 --motion 6
shots.negative_prompt: abrupt jump cut, camera shake, low framerate, stuttering motion, distorted hands, modern clothes, deformed animals, blurry face, plastic, oversaturated
shots.audio_cue: 7.5s 小贩高亢叫卖（刚出屉的热炊饼、水晶蒸饺嘞！） + 11.0s 孩童追逐欢闹（快看白汽变大金鲤鱼飞走啦！） + 竹木掀盖拟音

shots.title: 百态众生 · 金色声浪
shots.camera: 浅景深微距稳定推进 (Macro Dolly-in) ➔ 85mm f/1.4 肖像锁焦 ➔ 平滑横摇
shots.positive_prompt: Intimate cinematic portrait dolly-in shot, perfectly stable focal plane, elegant young Song Dynasty woman in pastel hanfu turning head gracefully with authentic smile, flawless anatomically correct facial features, hyper-realistic facial symmetry, consistent bone structure, natural eye blink, steady gaze, lifelike skin texture, 85mm portrait lens with creamy bokeh; seamless continuous pan to rugged blacksmith striking anvil where flying sparks magically blossom into showers of glowing golden peony petals; surreal phenomenon: visible transparent golden acoustic soundwave ripples expanding horizontally through the air from street vendors shouting, vibrating thousands of copper windchimes gently, warm golden hour sunlight, temporally coherent, zero facial morphing, masterpiece lighting, 8k --ar 16:9 --motion 5
shots.negative_prompt: facial distortion, melted face, deformed face, bad eyes, asymmetric pupils, shifting facial features, warped jaw, ugly expression, cross-eyed, plastic face, duplicate nose, mutant fingers, jittery motion, stutter, uncanny valley, flicker
shots.audio_cue: 16.5s 逛街女子闲谈（这蜀锦料子真水灵） + 21.5s 同伴回应（前头还有吐火杂耍） + 万千铜风铃音波共振

shots.title: 星昼交融 · 万家灯火
shots.camera: 螺旋盘旋升空长镜头 (Epic Ascending Orbit) ➔ 全景俯瞰
shots.positive_prompt: Grand finale continuous ascending orbit shot rising smoothly from bustling street level into the breathtaking twilight sky, uninterrupted camera momentum, surreal cosmic phenomenon: sky divided in two, western sky ablaze in brilliant crimson and gold sunset, eastern sky deep velvet midnight glittering with the Milky Way galaxy, millions of warm glowing paper lanterns ascending gracefully from every courtyard like an inverted river of golden stars, illuminating miles of ancient Song Dynasty palaces, canals, and glowing night markets, ultimate Eastern prosperity and celestial grandeur, steady cinematic elevation, seamless optical flow, Arri Alexa 65 look, 8k resolution --ar 16:9 --motion 6
shots.negative_prompt: abrupt jump, stutter, camera drop, jerky motion, low resolution, dark apocalypse, modern electricity, neon glow, blur, noise, artifacts
shots.audio_cue: 24.0s 茶楼小二迎客 + 26~32s 万人欢腾声浪 + 激昂古琴大鼓交响高潮
